how: We read the website of every Raleigh-Durham wedding DJ listed on Lazo (34 listings, 24 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national booking agency, a venue, a company headquartered in Rochester with a Raleigh page, and a photo-booth crew with little about DJing. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle the ceremony audio and the toasts, not just the dance floor, especially for an outdoor ceremony in the heat?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Elite DJ Solutions
picks.blurb: Elite DJ Solutions in Apex offers more than 20 years of experience and prints its pricing: the Elite Wedding Reception, four hours included, is $1,395, with every event customizable from there. The team says its DJs have been recognized on The Knot and WeddingWire.

picks.name: Willis J. Entertainment
picks.blurb: Willis has been a DJ for almost 20 years, a military brat raised on the records of a Bronx-born West Indian mother and a southern father. Willis J Entertainment in Durham bundles DJ, lighting, photo booth and day-of coordination into customizable packages.

picks.name: All Events DJs
picks.blurb: Victor Vispetto founded All Events DJs in 2011 after 20 years as a DJ, and runs it with general manager Nina Vispetto out of Fuquay-Varina. A team of DJ entertainers and MCs with lighting and photo booths, and the site describes the company as award-winning.

picks.name: Stylus S.E.
picks.blurb: Stylus Weddings brings experienced DJs, polished emcees, professional sound and what it calls calm event leadership to weddings across North Carolina. Apex-based, with custom music, lighting and photo booths, and a promise of a smooth timeline rather than just a playlist.

picks.name: Bunn DJ Company
picks.blurb: Joe Bunn got the mixing bug at 13 in Wilson, spun in UNC-Chapel Hill fraternity basements and Wilmington beach bars, and went full-time after moving to Raleigh in 2000. Bunn DJ Company now fields a team of wedding DJs with photo booths and cites more than 2,000 clients.

picks.name: CWDJ ENTERTAINMENT
picks.blurb: CWDJ stands for Carolina Wedding DJ: a boutique Raleigh company doing wedding and corporate entertainment in Raleigh, Garner, Clayton, Durham, Chapel Hill, Apex and Wake Forest, and traveling to Wilmington, the Outer Banks and Asheville by request.

picks.name: Raleigh Wedding DJ and Video
picks.blurb: James and Amanda believe you should know exactly what your entertainment costs before you sign, so the price is on the homepage: a 4-hour wedding reception is regularly $795, or $720 on the spring 2027 offer, with wedding video from the same company. Raleigh.

picks.name: Ultra Mix Events
picks.blurb: Matt Butterworth launched Ultra Mix Events to raise the bar on the wedding DJ experience, naming it for his love of electronic dance music. Expect higher energy, lighting production, special effects, visuals and big sound, with remix-leaning tracks meant to still appeal to everyone. Raleigh.

picks.name: DJ Sobel Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Sobel in Louisburg aims to feel like family by the end of your wedding day. The wedding package lists 8 hours of DJ service for ceremony and reception, separate speakers for the ceremony and cocktail hour and a lapel mic for the officiant, with a sing-along service available as a main event or add-on.

picks.name: McSound Productions
picks.blurb: McSound's owner played drums professionally in the 1980s and started DJing in 1985 after a Durham nightclub manager heard his party tapes. Over 20 years of experience from Hillsborough, for weddings and mitzvahs, with a stated eye on your budget.

picks.name: Southern Elegance Events
picks.blurb: Patrick Dorsett is the full-time owner and lead DJ of Southern Elegance Events in Chatham County, having started in 2011 as a roadie and DJ under Ben Suggs of Southern Entertainment. The pitch: it is your event, and the DJs do not hide behind a logo.

picks.name: Joey's DJ Service
picks.blurb: Joey is a DJ and MC with over 15 years of experience, serving North Carolina and southern Virginia from Durham by reading the room and keeping the flow moving from the first conversation to the last song. Weddings, school dances and private events.
